claim: The default quota of active DML queries in Athena depends on the Region: 200 in us-east-1, 150 in us-east-2, us-west-2, ap-northeast-1, eu-central-1 and eu-west-1, 100 in ap-northeast-2, ap-south-1, ap-southeast-1, ap-southeast-2 and eu-west-2, and 20 in each of the other supported Regions. The quota is adjustable.
question: Athena: what is the default quota of active DML queries per Region, and is it adjustable?

values.display: 20 in each of the other supported Regions
values.spoken: twenty in each of the other supported Regions

qualifiers.scope: active DML queries (SELECT, CTAS, INSERT INTO), per Region, per account
qualifiers.condition: Value depends on the Region; running and queued queries both count (see the service-limits page).
